title: Brookings report recommends possible withholding of ET artifacts

tellings.quote: And even before that, NASA commissioned uh the Brookings report in 1959. It was published in 1960.

plain: In 1959 NASA commissioned the Brookings Institution to write a report on the effects of space exploration, published in 1960, which a guest named Maaneli Derakhshani reads as recommending that any alien artifacts found might be kept from the public. He tells Michels about it as early evidence that hiding such a discovery was considered from the very start of NASA. No words of the report itself are given, so the reading rests on how he sums it up.
